_note: §1a.6: no module ships without a learning / reasoning / depth verdict, each
pass or fail with the evidence named. `n/a` is a first-class answer - a
Parquet writer does not reason - but it must be stated, not left blank.
A verdict is a judgement and this file is where the judgement is recorded.
What is CHECKED mechanically by `integrity.axis_verdicts` is that every axis
is answered, that the answer is one of pass/fail/n/a, and that every named
artifact is on disk. A verdict citing a test nobody wrote fails the check.
Completed 2026-08-09 for every module in src/. Four carry an explicit FAIL
and that is the point of the exercise: a standard that produces only passes
is a standard nobody fails. Three fail DEPTH because nothing calls them - a
module that cannot run cannot change what the system does when it is wrong,
which is the master test - and one because no test exercises it at all.

validation.breadth.learning: pass: no constant in the decision path is typed. The trigger threshold is a percentile of each symbol's OWN history (L1), and the collapse band 5-15 is quoted from §5a.4 rather than chosen here - a gate that picked its own threshold would be grading itself against a number selected to pass
validation.breadth.reasoning: pass: it distinguishes clustered arrivals from correlated outcomes and says which it found. The first draft read §5a.4's 'cluster AND correlate' as a disjunction and would have reported REDESIGN on data the spec does not call one; the conjunction is now pinned by a test
validation.breadth.depth: pass: changes behaviour when wrong. REDESIGN is a reachable verdict that stops Phase 4, and INCONCLUSIVE is returned rather than a number whenever the sample cannot support one

validation.promotion_pipeline.learning: pass: every configuration scored is a Trial Registry entry, and the N that deflates the winner is the registry's cumulative count (L7) - a wider search raises its own bar
validation.promotion_pipeline.reasoning: pass: it caught a lookahead in its own candidate. Pure noise scored Sharpe 3.90 and passed three of five gates; the return definition was selecting on information that had not settled. Both the noise case and the real-edge case are tests, because a stack that refuses everything measures nothing
validation.promotion_pipeline.depth: pass: the master test. A refusal is the designed outcome, and the gates compose with AND so no single one can be outvoted

risk.tail_cap.learning: pass: the operating ladder is derived from a block-bootstrapped drawdown distribution rather than from the single realised maximum (VX-011), and the ceiling is read from a file the user owns rather than fitted at all
risk.tail_cap.reasoning: pass: it separates what it may change from what it may not. Every derived rung is clamped to the user's ceiling and the clamping is recorded - §6's line made mechanical rather than checked
risk.tail_cap.depth: pass: a missing ceiling FAILS rather than being skipped, and paper breaches are recorded as `would_have_breached` instead of being silently unenforced

store.funding_backfill.learning: n/a: it fetches and stores settled numbers. Nothing here is fitted and nothing claims to be
store.funding_backfill.reasoning: n/a: no decision is taken from the data it writes
store.funding_backfill.depth: pass: the safeguard is mechanical rather than documented. Availability time is the fetch, so every simulated clock in the past sees an empty dataset and no backtest can consume it by accident

integrity.unsupported_claims.learning: n/a: a static analysis. Nothing is fitted
integrity.unsupported_claims.reasoning: pass: it distinguishes three states rather than two - running, reachable only by hand, and unreachable - because its first version called nine hand-run modules dead and a check that cries wolf gets switched off
integrity.unsupported_claims.depth: pass: it changes what happens when the project is wrong about itself. The ratchet fails in BOTH directions, so fixing a claim without updating the baseline is also an error

integrity.axis_verdicts.learning: n/a: a coverage check over a record. Nothing is fitted
integrity.axis_verdicts.reasoning: pass: it separates what it can measure from what it cannot. The verdict is a judgement; coverage and the existence of named evidence are measured, and the module says which is which
integrity.axis_verdicts.depth: pass: modules are enumerated from `src/` rather than from this file, so a module added without a verdict makes the number fall instead of leaving the omission invisible

ops.venue_health_watch.learning: n/a: it forwards measured health reports to a registry. No parameter is fitted
ops.venue_health_watch.reasoning: pass: a venue whose report cannot be built is named rather than skipped, because a silent skip leaves the registry serving a stale verdict with nothing saying the input stopped
ops.venue_health_watch.depth: pass: it is what makes the halt registry a mechanism rather than a library - `observe()` had zero callers while the wall claimed the auto-halt was armed

capture.venues.bybit.learning: n/a: a venue adapter. Nothing is fitted
capture.venues.bybit.reasoning: pass: it checks `retCode` before reading a body, because this venue answers HTTP 200 with errors, and it skips dated futures on the venue's own empty `fundingRate` rather than on a naming heuristic
capture.venues.bybit.depth: pass: `ws_url` raises rather than returning a URL nobody meant to connect, and the venue's clock is merged onto each record so a row can be dated without the envelope it arrived in

capture.venues.binance_funding.learning: n/a: a venue adapter. Nothing is fitted
capture.venues.binance_funding.reasoning: pass: it exists because of a measured comparison - binance-spot survived the hour boundary with more writers, so the burst was the difference rather than the total - and the module records that the threshold was never proven
capture.venues.binance_funding.depth: pass: the funding spec is defined once and returned only here, so the recorder cannot start polling it again by accident and the two processes cannot drift on cadence or weight

capture.raw_writer.learning: n/a: writes bytes. No parameter is fitted
capture.raw_writer.reasoning: pass: refuses an hour it cannot append to rather than guessing `n`, and states in its own docstring what a marker it could not place costs
capture.raw_writer.depth: pass: the flush cadence bounds crash loss to the frames since the last zstd boundary, and ordering is load-bearing - raw is fsynced before the index footer so an interrupted close can never leave the index ahead of the data

capture.venue_recorder.learning: pass: the silence threshold is a 0.90 quantile over each stream's own recent gaps, not a constant. A high-water mark was tried first and taught the check to ignore the stalls it existed to catch (L1)
capture.venue_recorder.reasoning: pass: it separates a slow stream from a dead one on repetition rather than on magnitude, because on first sight a 200 s gap on a 200 s stream and a 200 s stall on a 1 s stream are identical
capture.venue_recorder.depth: pass: a damaged hour is quarantined per (stream, symbol) rather than taking the venue down, and the frames lost are counted rather than dropped

capture.sequencing.learning: pass: the staleness baseline is learned from each stream's observed cadence, and the learning rule's own failure mode is documented where it is set
capture.sequencing.reasoning: pass: gap detection is per venue by construction - Binance chains depth on U/u/pu and Hyperliquid publishes no sequence at all, so the second gets staleness rather than a chain it does not have
capture.sequencing.depth: pass: a break in the chain is recorded as a corrupting ledger event, which is what stops a reconstructed book being trusted

capture.capture_health.learning: n/a: it counts what the ledger recorded. Nothing is fitted
capture.capture_health.reasoning: pass: it distinguishes a stream that never connected from a market that never traded, and reports an uninitialised capture as its own state rather than as absence
capture.capture_health.depth: pass: a mistyped severity is bucketed rather than raised, so one odd ledger line cannot leave a whole venue-day unreported - which would be indistinguishable from healthy

capture.capture_ledger.learning: n/a: an append-only event log. Nothing is fitted
capture.capture_ledger.reasoning: n/a: it records what it is told and decides nothing
capture.capture_ledger.depth: pass: anomalies are first-class queryable events rather than log lines, which is what lets every check above read them

capture.frame_codec.learning: n/a: byte-exact framing. Nothing is fitted
capture.frame_codec.reasoning: n/a: no decision is taken here
capture.frame_codec.depth: pass: escaping is reversible and the index entry is encoded before either file is written, so a failure cannot leave raw and index disagreeing

capture.repair_archive.learning: n/a: a filesystem repair pass. Nothing is fitted
capture.repair_archive.reasoning: pass: it distinguishes an hour a live writer holds from a torn one, and the two scopes are disjoint by construction so the background pass cannot reach an hour a recorder is opening
capture.repair_archive.depth: pass: markers are swept at any age and in any venue precisely because a stale one is silent - one blocked an hour from every backup for six days

capture.rest_poller.learning: n/a: a polling loop. Nothing is fitted
capture.rest_poller.reasoning: pass: it spends the shared rate budget BEFORE asking, so a poll that cannot afford its weight is skipped rather than earning a per-IP ban for every process
capture.rest_poller.depth: pass: a failed fetch yields no frame rather than propagating, because letting a 500 out would take that venue's whole capture down with it - and the silence is still visible as a stream producing nothing

capture.universe_tracker.learning: n/a: it records membership as observed. Nothing is fitted
capture.universe_tracker.reasoning: pass: a snapshot that cannot be believed is refused rather than recorded, and a malformed quote map is distinguished from an absent one - the two must not collapse
capture.universe_tracker.depth: pass: membership is point-in-time, so a symbol listed today cannot be assumed to have existed yesterday

capture.cli.learning: n/a: an entry point. Nothing is fitted
capture.cli.reasoning: pass: it shards subscriptions against a measured URL budget rather than a documented stream cap, because the request line dies before the cap does
capture.cli.depth: pass: a dying shard propagates rather than being swallowed - a process capturing three quarters of the universe is worse than one that visibly failed

capture.record_universe_snapshot.learning: n/a: fetches and records. Nothing is fitted
capture.record_universe_snapshot.reasoning: n/a: it takes no decision from what it records
capture.record_universe_snapshot.depth: pass: the quote currency is captured WITH membership, point-in-time, because a map fetched later covers a different set of symbols than the day being read

capture.capture_console.learning: n/a: a display. Nothing is fitted
capture.capture_console.reasoning: pass: it reads freshness from file mtimes rather than the ledger, because a stream silently doing nothing writes no events - the absence is the condition that must be visible, and only the archive carries it. It also reports a quarantined hour from the ledger, which file freshness gets exactly backwards: `reconcile_pair` rewrites the files a refused stream is not writing to, so a repaired hour looks freshly written while the recorder still refuses it
capture.capture_console.depth: pass: cleared 2026-08-09, having failed for having no test at all. Nine tests now drive the FAILING states rather than the happy path - a stopped stream renders STALE in both the text and the HTML, a quarantined hour is surfaced, restarts are surfaced because a recorder restarting every two minutes looks identical to a healthy one in a snapshot of file ages, an empty archive renders rather than raising, and a symbol that is filename-legal but markup-dangerous is escaped. It also needs no server process that could itself die and take the view with it

capture.venues.learning: n/a: a venue adapter - the shared spec types and the URL-budget sharder. Nothing is fitted
capture.venues.reasoning: pass: every channel choice here is a measurement rather than a reading of the docs - aggTrade delivers nothing to this host, markPrice delivers nothing over the socket and was moved to a poll, forceOrder is withheld and kept subscribed so recovery would be noticed
capture.venues.depth: pass: a stream the venue withholds stays subscribed and its tile stays red, rather than being quietly dropped and reported as healthy

capture.venues.binance.learning: n/a: a venue adapter - the perp adapter. Nothing is fitted
capture.venues.binance.reasoning: pass: every channel choice here is a measurement rather than a reading of the docs - aggTrade delivers nothing to this host, markPrice delivers nothing over the socket and was moved to a poll, forceOrder is withheld and kept subscribed so recovery would be noticed
capture.venues.binance.depth: pass: a stream the venue withholds stays subscribed and its tile stays red, rather than being quietly dropped and reported as healthy

capture.venues.binance_spot.learning: n/a: a venue adapter - the spot adapter. Nothing is fitted
capture.venues.binance_spot.reasoning: pass: every channel choice here is a measurement rather than a reading of the docs - aggTrade delivers nothing to this host, markPrice delivers nothing over the socket and was moved to a poll, forceOrder is withheld and kept subscribed so recovery would be noticed
capture.venues.binance_spot.depth: pass: a stream the venue withholds stays subscribed and its tile stays red, rather than being quietly dropped and reported as healthy

capture.venues.hyperliquid.learning: n/a: a venue adapter - the hyperliquid adapter. Nothing is fitted
capture.venues.hyperliquid.reasoning: pass: every channel choice here is a measurement rather than a reading of the docs - aggTrade delivers nothing to this host, markPrice delivers nothing over the socket and was moved to a poll, forceOrder is withheld and kept subscribed so recovery would be noticed
capture.venues.hyperliquid.depth: pass: a stream the venue withholds stays subscribed and its tile stays red, rather than being quietly dropped and reported as healthy

store.clock_gated_reader.learning: n/a: a reader. Nothing is fitted
store.clock_gated_reader.reasoning: pass: it resolves corrections by (symbol, venue, event_time) keeping the last visible version, and the key includes venue because two venues legitimately share a symbol and an event time
store.clock_gated_reader.depth: pass: it is the ONLY door, so a windowing off-by-one cannot differ between backtest and live - and joins key on availability, never event time, with no parameter to change that

store.temporal_schema.learning: n/a: a schema. Nothing is fitted
store.temporal_schema.reasoning: n/a: it asserts invariants and decides nothing
store.temporal_schema.depth: pass: a frame missing a required timestamp is refused at write time, which is why no later reader has to defend against it

store.parquet_partition.learning: n/a: a writer. Nothing is fitted
store.parquet_partition.reasoning: pass: the snapshot id is content-derived, so a rebuild collides by design and a correction is a new snapshot rather than a rewrite
store.parquet_partition.depth: pass: schemas are unified across fragments before reading - without it a column added by a later partition is silently dropped, which cost `funding_interval_hours` on 2026-08-09

store.trade_bars.learning: n/a: an aggregation. Nothing is fitted
store.trade_bars.reasoning: pass: each bar carries when it became knowable rather than when it happened, which is what makes the gate above it meaningful
store.trade_bars.depth: pass: a zero price is refused rather than aggregated - 746 bars ate placeholder frames into `low` via `min()` and every one of them looked normal

store.cli.learning: n/a: a build entry point. Nothing is fitted
store.cli.reasoning: pass: it builds from EVENT time with a bounded lookahead rather than from the folder a frame landed in, and drops only what is known not to be dollar-quoted - unknown and unlisted are built and named
store.cli.depth: pass: a trade no build will ever read is quarantined and counted rather than dropped, and a live hour is skipped rather than read as an empty market

store.funding_rates.learning: n/a: a projection of archived polls. Nothing is fitted
store.funding_rates.reasoning: pass: it carries which price each venue funds on, because Binance funds on mark and Hyperliquid on oracle and a cross-venue carry number that does not know which is comparing two quantities
store.funding_rates.depth: pass: no observations is an empty frame, never a zero rate - charging zero funding to a carry strategy is the optimistic default, not the conservative one

store.book_snapshots.learning: n/a: a projection of archived snapshots. Nothing is fitted
store.book_snapshots.reasoning: n/a: it stores what was polled and decides nothing
store.book_snapshots.depth: pass: availability is keyed on receipt, so a snapshot cannot be read before it arrived

store.build_polled.learning: n/a: a builder. Nothing is fitted
store.build_polled.reasoning: pass: the stream and reader are chosen per venue, so one dataset holds three funding models rather than pushing 'which venue am I holding' onto every consumer
store.build_polled.depth: pass: a live hour is skipped rather than read, and no rows appends nothing rather than writing an empty dataset over the old one

store.quote_currency.learning: n/a: a classification from the venue's own field. Nothing is fitted
store.quote_currency.reasoning: pass: three groups, not two - 'not known to be a dollar' and 'known not to be' are different facts, and folding them would shrink the universe on the day a stablecoin listed
store.quote_currency.depth: pass: never parsed from the symbol string, because BTCU is BTC quoted in U and XRPRLUSD is quoted in RLUSD

store.correct_bars.learning: n/a: a republish. Nothing is fitted
store.correct_bars.reasoning: n/a: it applies a correction it is given
store.correct_bars.depth: pass: a correction is a new bitemporal row, never a rewrite, so what was believed at the time stays readable

cost.fee_schedule.learning: n/a: a declared table of what venues charge. Every rate is a disclosed design input, which L1 explicitly permits - what it forbids is a typed number wearing a fitted name
cost.fee_schedule.reasoning: pass: it carries how much each claim can be trusted, so a rate read from a doc and a rate verified against the venue are not the same object
cost.fee_schedule.depth: pass: fees are Decimal basis points, never float, because a representation error here prices every trade

cost.fee_fetcher.learning: n/a: fetches what a venue publishes. Nothing is fitted
cost.fee_fetcher.reasoning: pass: it records that Binance answers 401 without a key while Hyperliquid publishes openly, rather than treating one venue's silence as the other's
cost.fee_fetcher.depth: pass: a stale verification is reported as stale - tiers move with 30-day volume, so an old fetch is a historical fact rather than a current one

cost.round_trip_cost.learning: n/a: arithmetic over declared and measured inputs. Nothing is fitted
cost.round_trip_cost.reasoning: pass: it REFUSES rather than defaulting when an input is missing or stale, and the refusal names what was missing - a quote produced from a default is the flattering answer
cost.round_trip_cost.depth: pass: the master test. It changes what happens when the system does not know something, by declining to price the trade

cost.funding_carry.learning: n/a: charges observed rates at observed settlements. Nothing is fitted
cost.funding_carry.reasoning: pass: the rate used at a settlement is the last one KNOWN at that settlement, never the newest - and a settlement with no prior observation raises rather than borrowing
cost.funding_carry.depth: pass: funding is charged at actual settlement times rather than smoothed, which is the difference between a carry cost and an average

cost.secret_store.learning: n/a: reads credentials. Nothing is fitted
cost.secret_store.reasoning: n/a: it decrypts and returns; no decision is taken
cost.secret_store.depth: pass: into memory only, never to disk, and the watchdog's credential denial depends on the identity file being the single point it reads

cost.cli.learning: n/a: an entry point. Nothing is fitted
cost.cli.reasoning: pass: it shows where every number came from rather than only the total, which is what makes a refusal diagnosable
cost.cli.depth: pass: a run that cannot price the trade says why, in the same words the engine used

cost.spread_and_depth.learning: n/a: book arithmetic. Nothing is fitted
cost.spread_and_depth.reasoning: pass: it prices what a book can actually fill rather than quoting the top of it, which is the difference between a spread and a cost
cost.spread_and_depth.depth: fail: cannot change what the system does, because nothing calls it. Reachable from no entry point - the reachability audit lists it as unreachable, and a component that cannot run cannot fail loudly either. Clears when a sizing path uses it

execution.order_intent_wal.learning: n/a: a journal. Nothing is fitted
execution.order_intent_wal.reasoning: pass: the intent is durable BEFORE the request is sent, so an unknown outcome is recoverable rather than invisible - and it never blind-retries
execution.order_intent_wal.depth: pass: it changes what happens after a crash, which is the only moment it exists for

execution.order_lifecycle.learning: n/a: state tracking. Nothing is fitted
execution.order_lifecycle.reasoning: pass: state is remaining quantity rather than a filled flag, because a partial fill is the normal case and a boolean cannot hold it
execution.order_lifecycle.depth: pass: a partially filled order cannot be mistaken for a complete one, which is what stops a double-send

execution.state_recovery.reasoning: pass: it refuses to start on a mismatch rather than adopting it - the prior art adopts or closes, which makes a symptom disappear while the cause keeps running
execution.state_recovery.depth: fail: cannot change what the system does, because nothing calls it. It needs venue truth from an authenticated session that does not exist, so the refusal it is built around can never fire. Tracked as RX-005, the last baselined unsupported claim

ops.rate_budget.learning: n/a: a token bucket. Capacities are measured from venue headers and disclosed, which is L1's permitted case
ops.rate_budget.reasoning: pass: the budget is shared through a locked state file rather than held per process, because two processes each within the limit are together over it
ops.rate_budget.depth: pass: it refuses a poll that cannot afford its weight, and a refused poll is cheaper than a per-IP ban that scales to three days

ops.venue_halt.learning: n/a: a state machine over health reports. Nothing is fitted
ops.venue_halt.reasoning: pass: it halts on corruption alone and REFUSES to halt on silence, with the reason written where the limit is set - the silence count is inflated by thin tail symbols and by a feed the venue withholds, so it cannot tell a sick venue from a wide one
ops.venue_halt.depth: pass: a halt persists across restarts, because a halt a restart clears is one an unhealthy venue escapes by killing the watcher; and recovery needs a sustained dwell rather than one clean sample

ops.watchdog.learning: n/a: a kill switch. Nothing is fitted
ops.watchdog.reasoning: pass: it reports honestly which mechanisms fired AND which cannot exist on this host - no sudo, no iptables, no nft, so the firewall half is unavailable and says so rather than reporting success
ops.watchdog.depth: pass: the kill file is written first and unconditionally, so even a half-completed trip stops trading; a later trip does not overwrite the first breach's reason

ops.raw_eviction.learning: n/a: a retention policy. Nothing is fitted
ops.raw_eviction.reasoning: pass: it drops only hours PROVEN to be in the bucket, so the local copy is never the last copy
ops.raw_eviction.depth: pass: retention lives in a file rather than a constant, so changing it does not require redeploying the thing that enforces it

paper.fill_model.learning: n/a: a fill rule with a disclosed participation parameter. Not fitted, and not claimed to be
paper.fill_model.reasoning: pass: it keeps optimistic and pessimistic accountings apart rather than averaging them into one number that is true of neither
paper.fill_model.depth: pass: a resting order that never printed does not fill, so an unfilled signal is visible as unfilled rather than as a trade at a hoped price

paper.participation_calibration.learning: n/a: it would estimate participation from prints, and does not run
paper.participation_calibration.reasoning: pass: the question it asks is the right one - how much of a print a resting order would actually have received, rather than a fixed fraction
paper.participation_calibration.depth: fail: cannot change what the system does, because nothing calls it. `paper.fill_model` still uses a disclosed constant, so the calibration this module exists to supply is not supplied. Clears when the fill model reads it

paper.prove_plumbing.learning: n/a: a crude fixed signal, deliberately - it exists to prove wiring, not edge
paper.prove_plumbing.reasoning: pass: it refuses to start while a kill is in force, before anything is journalled, and reports realised P&L only for round trips that closed
paper.prove_plumbing.depth: pass: it drives every layer end to end, which is how the WAL, the fill model and the cost engine were shown to carry a fill at all

risk.drawdown_distribution.learning: pass: the ladder's levels come from a block bootstrap over observed returns rather than from round numbers or from the single realised maximum (L1)
risk.drawdown_distribution.reasoning: pass: it distinguishes the worst that happened from the worst to plan for, and carries both so the gap is visible where the decision is made
risk.drawdown_distribution.depth: pass: the block bootstrap preserves the serial dependence that makes drawdowns deep, which an IID resample would destroy and report as safety

statuswall.evidence.learning: n/a: probes measure; nothing is fitted
statuswall.evidence.reasoning: pass: every probe returns what it found and names where the answer came from, and a feature with no probe is NOT_BUILT by construction rather than by omission
statuswall.evidence.depth: pass: one raising probe fails its own tile and leaves the board standing, because a board that renders nothing is useless exactly when something is wrong

statuswall.wall_page.learning: n/a: a renderer. Nothing is fitted
statuswall.wall_page.reasoning: n/a: it renders verdicts it is given
statuswall.wall_page.depth: pass: `STATE_STYLE` has no fallback, so an unhandled state is a crash rather than a green tile - and NOT MEASURED is off the health colour axis so it cannot read as 'nearly OK'

statuswall.catalogue.learning: n/a: a parser. Nothing is fitted
statuswall.catalogue.reasoning: pass: it reads the catalogue rather than restating it, and refuses tables that are not feature tables - a worked Zomma example would otherwise become permanently unmeasurable tiles
statuswall.catalogue.depth: pass: a probe pointing at a feature the catalogue no longer contains RAISES, because a silently orphaned probe stops reporting a real measurement and nothing looks wrong

statuswall.cli.learning: n/a: an entry point. Nothing is fitted
statuswall.cli.reasoning: pass: it refuses to render a board from a catalogue that parsed to nothing, so a parse failure reports itself rather than as every probe orphaned at once
statuswall.cli.depth: pass: the board is rebuilt from live measurement on a cadence; serving a file and refreshing it are different jobs and only one of them used to be anyone's

statuswall.board_server.learning: n/a: a static file server. Nothing is fitted
statuswall.board_server.reasoning: n/a: it serves what the generator wrote
statuswall.board_server.depth: pass: bound to loopback behind HTTP Basic, so the tunnel is the only exposure and credentials are generated rather than defaulted

validation.trial_registry.learning: pass: N is the count of candidates EVALUATED, counted before evaluation, which is L7's requirement rather than a tally of what was kept
validation.trial_registry.reasoning: pass: a trial is claimed and written under one lock, because two search processes reading the same count would both claim it and the ledger would lose a row
validation.trial_registry.depth: pass: a candidate that crashes is recorded as abandoned and still counts - a search that could shed trials by failing could shrink its own N at will

validation.deflated_sharpe.learning: pass: the hurdle is computed from the observed dispersion of trials rather than a chosen threshold
validation.deflated_sharpe.reasoning: pass: it is fed the registry's cumulative N, never the CPCV path count - the donor version was fed the path count and deflated a candidate picked from thousands as though 15 things were tried
validation.deflated_sharpe.depth: pass: MinBTL is a hard gate rather than a report, and it rises with N so a wider search demands more history

validation.purged_cross_validation.learning: n/a: a splitting scheme. Nothing is fitted
validation.purged_cross_validation.reasoning: pass: the purge reaches BOTH ways - the donor's exclusion zone started at the test start and leaked one label horizon of training rows into every block
validation.purged_cross_validation.depth: pass: an undeclared family raises rather than defaulting the horizon to zero, which would silently disable the purge entirely

validation.backtest_overfitting.learning: n/a: an estimator over supplied return series. Nothing is fitted
validation.backtest_overfitting.reasoning: pass: it measures the SELECTION procedure rather than the winner, which is why it needs the whole search's results and not the finalists'
validation.backtest_overfitting.depth: pass: it caught a lookahead the deflated Sharpe, MinBTL and purge gates all passed - pure noise at PBO 0.613

validation.superior_predictive_ability.learning: n/a: a bootstrap test. Nothing is fitted
validation.superior_predictive_ability.reasoning: pass: it reports Hansen's consistent p-value beside White's reality check rather than only the one that flatters
validation.superior_predictive_ability.depth: pass: it refused the pure-noise candidate that the deflated Sharpe passed at N=1, which is the argument for several independent gates rather than a better single one

validation.holdout_custodian.learning: n/a: a guard. Nothing is fitted
validation.holdout_custodian.reasoning: pass: it refuses a read inside the sealed range and records the refusal, and freezing is distinguished from consuming because a peeked score is indistinguishable from an honest one
validation.holdout_custodian.depth: pass: the refusal IS the feature, and it is enforced at the reader rather than by convention

validation.promotion_gate.learning: pass: every threshold traces to the registry's N or to a measured distribution, not to a chosen number
validation.promotion_gate.reasoning: pass: the whole CPCV sweep happens inside ONE registry evaluation, which is why the path count can never reach the trial count
validation.promotion_gate.depth: pass: gates compose with AND, and a candidate is registered before it is scored so a crash cannot shed the trial

statuswall.build_progress.learning: n/a: a renderer over measurements made elsewhere. Nothing is fitted
statuswall.build_progress.reasoning: pass: it reconciles by method, not by trust - the ledger counter mirrors the reference parser's row rules after its first draft counted totals tables as requirement rows and reported 109 against the index's 108; the trap is pinned by a test
statuswall.build_progress.depth: pass: it changes behaviour when wrong. A FEATURES.md section no phase claims RAISES rather than silently under-counting a phase, an absent ledger renders NOT MEASURED rather than zero, and paper trading renders NOT RUNNING until a journal exists

capture.venues.bybit_liquidation.learning: n/a: a capture adapter. Nothing is fitted - the one number in its decision path (21,000 subscribe chars) is the venue's own documented ceiling, quoted not chosen
capture.venues.bybit_liquidation.reasoning: pass: it was written against the wire, not the docs - the stream was probed from this host (16 frames in 90s) before the module existed, because the Binance lesson is that a subscribe ack proves nothing. Its universe parser refuses a paginated listing rather than silently truncating it
capture.venues.bybit_liquidation.depth: pass: it changes behaviour when wrong. A second listing page RAISES with the fix named; an error body wearing HTTP 200 yields no instruments; a malformed row falls back to the topic's own symbol rather than orphaning the frame; and declaring the stream market-wide moved silence to the unit that can actually die - the whole feed - after per-symbol judgement condemned 800 of 805 symbols in one 75-second run

features.spot_perp_basis.learning: n/a: one subtraction over stored prices. Nothing is fitted - the module's work is refusing to subtract against the wrong reference
features.spot_perp_basis.reasoning: pass: the reference is chosen by the row's own funds_on declaration, never the venue name, so a fourth venue arriving with funds_on=oracle prices correctly without an edit and an unrecognised declaration refuses rather than guesses. Its refusal accounting found two real store defects on first live contact: binance rows unstamped, and the intraday build frozen at its first pass
features.spot_perp_basis.depth: pass: refusals ride the result as counts by reason, so a consumer cannot mistake sparse data for a calm market; a zero reference is refused rather than divided by; every read is clock-gated, so a history assembled from past clocks is leak-free by construction

features.peg_monitor.learning: pass: no constant in the decision path is typed. The peg LEVEL is the median of each asset's own reference window (so EURI is judged at 1.156, not at a hardcoded 1.0), the breach distance is that asset's own worst wobble while it held, and the floor under it is the cost engine's measured round-trip from verified fee schedules. The fixed part is four declared items - window length, two dispersion bands, minimum history - named in the module docstring rather than buried
features.peg_monitor.reasoning: pass: which assets are pegged is measured, never spelled, and the live data proves the spelling rule wrong in both directions - TUSDT is the T token at $0.0037 and is refused on its volatility, while EURIUSDT is a real peg at $1.16 that a dollar assumption would report permanently broken. Assets between the bands are returned undecided rather than forced. Two structural defects were found by their own failing tests: judging a bar against statistics it contributed to made a depeg invisible, and classifying on the whole window made a peg that walked disappear as 'never was a peg'
features.peg_monitor.depth: fail: nothing consumes a breach. The intended consumer is position sizing on assets quoted in a broken peg, and no sizer exists - so by the master test this cannot yet change what the system does when it is wrong. Recorded as a fail rather than deferred: this is the tail_specs shape, and the wall's tile says the same thing rather than reading green

features.consolidated_price.learning: n/a: a weighted mean over stored books. Nothing is fitted - but nothing in the decision path is typed either: the weight is measured depth, the comparison band is the widest contributing spread, and the staleness limit is each venue's own measured cadence times a multiple already established in capture.venue_recorder rather than a second number chosen here
features.consolidated_price.reasoning: pass: it is built against the two ways a venue lies rather than against the happy path. A thin venue quoting a moved price is outvoted by depth (the Mango shape - an equal-weighted mean of 100 and 200 gives 150; this gives 100.0), and a FROZEN venue is excluded despite intact depth, which is the more dangerous case precisely because staleness preserves weight. Venue disagreement rides every row instead of being smoothed away
features.consolidated_price.depth: pass: it changes behaviour when wrong. Asked at wall-clock now it returns NOTHING and counts six stale exclusions rather than pricing off an 82-minute-old book - the store builds closed hours, and that lag is now a measured headline on the wall instead of an assumption. Every exclusion is counted by reason, and a one-venue price reports venues_used=1 rather than passing as a consensus
